features.title: Built for South Africa
features.subtitle: From township businesses to Joburg startups — Purple Glow gets the way we do things here. No overseas nonsense, just tools that work for you.

aiEngine.title: AI That Writes Your Posts
aiEngine.description: Just tell us what you're selling or sharing. Our AI writes posts that sound like you — in English, isiZulu, Afrikaans, or any of our 11 languages.

multilingual.title: All 11 SA Languages
multilingual.description: Post in isiZulu this morning, Afrikaans at lunch, English tonight. Your customers will love seeing their language. Switch whenever you want.

scheduling.title: Post on Autopilot
scheduling.description: Schedule a whole month of posts in 10 minutes. Purple Glow picks the best times to post so you get the most eyes on your content.

step1.title: Tell Us About Your Business
step1.description: What are you selling? Who are your customers? What vibe fits your brand? Set it up once and you're good to go.

step2.title: AI Writes Your Posts
step2.description: Our AI creates posts for Instagram, Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn — in the language your customers speak.

step3.title: Approve & Post
step3.description: Check the posts, make small changes if you want, then schedule them. Purple Glow handles the rest. You focus on running your business.
